entities.summary: Kenneth Stephen Wilsbach is an American general who serves as the 24th chief of staff of the United States Air Force since 2025. He previously served as the commander of Air Combat Command from 2024 to 2025, and prior to that, he served as the commander of Pacific Air Forces from 2020 to 2024.
